text: What was wrong with the man's story?
zh: 这个人的叙述有什么问题？
zh_hant: 這個人的敘述有什麼問題？

text: 'At the time the murder was committed,
I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.
zh: “我正乘坐8点的火车去伦敦，”那人说。
zh_hant: “我正乘坐8點的火車去倫敦，”那人說。

text: 'Do you always catch such an early train?'
asked the inspector.
'Of course I do,' answered the man.
'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'
zh: 我的雇主会证实我准时到了。”
zh_hant: 我的僱主會證實我準時到了。”

text: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?'
zh: “晚一点的火车也能让你准时上班吗？”
zh_hant: “晚一點的火車也能讓你準時上班嗎？”

text: asked the inspector.
'I suppose it would,
but I never catch a later train.'
'At what time
did you arrive at the station?'
'At ten to eight.
I bought a paper and waited for the train.'
'And you didn't notice
anything unusual?'
'Of course not.'
'I suggest,'
said the inspector,' that you are not telling the truth.
I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train,
zh: 我认为你没有坐8点的火车，
zh_hant: 我認為你沒有坐8點的火車，

text: but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
zh: 而是坐了8点25分的，那班车同样能让你准时上班。
zh_hant: 而是坐了8點25分的，那班車同樣能讓你準時上班。

text: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train
zh: 你看，在谋杀发生的那天早上，8点的火车
zh_hant: 你看，在謀殺發生的那天早上，8點的火車

text: did not run at all.
It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'
zh: 它在费恩格林站出了故障，被撤下了线路。”
zh_hant: 它在費恩格林站出了故障，被撤下了線路。”
